verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of an API versioning scheme and no deprecation policy. One doc URL path contains 'list-customer-contracts-v2', but the quoted text says nothing about versioning or deprecation. Archiving billable metrics is a data-lifecycle feature, not an API deprecation policy, so it earns no credit here.
